purpose: CTUI-53 direct-public-API capability rejection evidence, not a production fix.
commands: nice -n 19 dart compile exe main.dart -o build/probe
reproduction: Copy .txt sources to their original names in an owned temporary package and resolve the retained lock. Executable path is normalized; all runs were sequential in an exclusive reserved slot.
observations: In both JIT and AOT the current-package public cancellation Future completes without cleanup ack; a REG current.data descriptor remains even after observed worker exit notification. Direct worker_manager gentle cancellation completes with gentle.data still open; only after the deterministic test processing gate is released does cleanup ack arrive and that descriptor disappear. The current.data descriptor remains until the isolated probe process exits.
interpretation: Neither direct API provides the required awaited file-cleanup barrier. Exit-notification ordering is callback ordering, not a measured physical exit time. No sleeps or polling establish the verdict; a 15-second watchdog bounds a hung probe only. Exit code zero means the expected capability-gap observations were verified, not package acceptance.
currentPackageSource: CancellableCompleter.onCancel completes its internal Future with error before invoking onCancel; CancellableIsolate.run then kills its private isolate, with no exposed async cleanup/join hook.
workerManagerSource: Task.cancel completes the task Future immediately; executeGentle sends cancel after that. dispose/kill does not wait for cooperative body cleanup.

sourceInspectedOnly.squadron7.4.5: Worker.send(token) fails its ForwardCompleter immediately on token cancellation; token.wrap is internal. No runtime/AOT probe claimed.
sourceInspectedOnly.isolate_manager6.3.2: stop delegates to dispose, which sends disposal, closes the controller and kills. Native onDispose is a void callback and is not awaited. No runtime/AOT probe claimed.

cleanup: Every owned probe root was removed; both isolated probe processes exited, worker processes/isolates did not keep either program alive, outer TMPDIR/XDG and executable were removed. Open current.data before probe-process exit is intentionally retained as failure evidence; no per-operation all-zero handle claim.
dependencyScope: Separate ignored probe package only. Production pubspec/lock/source unchanged. Other candidates were downloaded/source-inspected only.
conditionalOwnerDirection: If these direct APIs cannot supply the barrier, main conditionally authorized a port-only cooperative SDK isolate worker with explicit file cleanup/acknowledgment. Short design and lead go-ahead are still required before production implementation.
